notes: §1985:VII.3.9.4 GR2: "all VALUE OF clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must be consistent. The implementor will specify the consistency rules." The rule is specified in docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3.7 (the agreement row) and implemented by the external connector's file description rules (kb/Work PB5300): two entries are consistent when every implementor-name both write is given the same literal-1 VALUE, and a data-name-1, known only at run time, is consistent with anything; a disagreement is COBOL6847 at the clause. kb/Work PB5362 (fixed): the literal was compared by its source text, so 'A' and "A" disagreed; it is compared by class and value now (ValueOfLiteralValue: 7 and 007.0 agree, SPACE and SPACES agree; 'A' and "A" would agree, but at COBOL-85, the only edition with VALUE OF, the apostrophe delimiter is refused, kb/Work PB5160, so an alphanumeric literal-1 has one spelling). Witnesses: pb5300-external-value-of-differs (FILE-ID "A" against "B", COBOL6847) and pb5362-external-value-of-same-value (RETENTION and OWNER spelled differently and equal in value, FILE-ID "A" in both, compiles and runs). The legal agreeing case is 1985-GR-VII_3_9_4-2. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/BinderDriver.cs#CheckExternalFileConsistency (named as where the check was missing (the code read's NOT-IMPLEMENTED); BinderDriver.CheckExternalFileConsistency no longer exists and the rule is FileDescriptionIdentity's VALUE OF row, asked by ExternalFileConnectorRules (kb/Work PB5300, PB5362)) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/FileEntryIdentity.cs#Of (named as where the check was missing (the code read's NOT-IMPLEMENTED); BinderDriver.CheckExternalFileConsistency no longer exists and the rule is FileDescriptionIdentity's VALUE OF row, asked by ExternalFileConnectorRules (kb/Work PB5300, PB5362))

next.reason: 1985: "all VALUE OF clauses in the run unit which are associated with that file connector must be consistent"; 2023: "No VALUE OF clause in 2023; no clause holds the feature, and the external-connector rules cover only ASSIGN, FORMAT, etc.". No 2023 clause carries the VALUE OF clause. The external file connector consistency rules found (file control entry, FORMAT) cover other clauses, so this requirement is dropped.
